name: Moon Defender 🌙
source:
A story about a trans woman who finds herself playing tabletop with "her friends". Finding friends who will love you and fighting your own demons are some of the objectives of the full game.

[From [url=https://cakychan.itch.io/moon-defender]itch.io[/url]]
